title: Automated audit evidence harvester: residency & retention control mapper
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Deliver an automated evidence collection and mapping system that ties residency and retention configuration artifacts to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls. This ticket scopes the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for a harvester that aggregates artifacts (configs, logs, policies) and produces control-specific evidence bundles for auditors and internal reviewers. Scope includes: control mapping matrix, evidence collectors for Storage configs (S3/GCS), VPC tenancy records, KMS key usage, retention policy configs, and a renderer that emits PDF/ZIP bundles plus machine-readable manifests for Console/Support consumption.
success_criteria: Control mapping matrix covering 95% of SOC 2 CC and ISO 27001 Annex A controls relevant to data residency/retention
Automated collectors ingest artifacts from 3 primary sources: cloud config APIs, Console export endpoints, and audit logs
Generated evidence bundles include source pointers, timestamps, and hash digests and can be produced in under 10 minutes for a typical customer workspace
Integration tests demonstrating end-to-end evidence generation for 2 customer residency scenarios (US-only, EU-only)
Product UX in Console: single-click 'Generate Compliance Package' visible in tenant settings
acceptance_criteria: PM/Engineering sign-off on control mapping and artifact schema
Security review completed with remediation for any P1 findings
Automated jobs run in staging and produce bundles that pass a compliance QA checklist
Documentation (Confluence) and runbook created for support responders
Telemetry emitted for evidence job success/failure and time-to-generate
proposed_solution_summary: Create a control-mapping service (control-catalog) that references SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and ISO 27001 Annex A controls. Implement collector adapters for: (1) cloud config APIs (S3 bucket location, GCS bucket location), (2) Console exports (retention policy JSON), (3) KMS usage logs, and (4) audit log slices. Collate artifacts into a standardized manifest, sign with a system key, and surface in Console + support UI. Use RBAC gating so only authorized roles can request packages.
milestones: Week 1: Finalize control mapping (draft) and artifact schema
Week 2-3: Implement core collectors (cloud config + console exports)
Week 4: End-to-end staging run and QA
Week 6: Console UX + docs + rollout to Beta customers

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Collectors may expose PII if logs are included. Mitigation: redact sensitive fields and allow scoped runs (configs-only).
Risk: Long-running log extracts will time out for large tenants. Mitigation: implement pagination + incremental snapshotting; surface ETA in Console.
Risk: Legal/regulatory disagreement on sufficiency of artifacts. Mitigation: include original source pointers and work with Legal to extend artifact set per region.

Release notes in Console and changelog
Support playbook internal training session (30m) prior to Beta
Post-beta retrospective + audit simulation with Internal Audit team
